_note: Every ticket below is an invented test fixture for this demo project, not a real user report — see the synthetic/note fields on each ticket, and crystal 31 (synthetic-data-memory-isolation) for why that distinction is load-bearing, not decorative.
_pii_scanner_note: ko/07-prompt-guardrails/scripts/public-repo-check.sh correctly flags TICKET-1046's contact info as email/phone-shaped text — that's the scanner working as designed, not a false positive to silence. Reviewed and kept intentionally: jane.doe@example.com uses the IANA-reserved example.com domain (RFC 2606, guaranteed to never resolve to a real mailbox) and 555-0148 uses the NANPA-reserved 555-01XX block (reserved for fictional use in media) — both are the standard way to write realistic-shaped-but-guaranteed-fake contact info, chosen deliberately so redact_pii() has something real to catch (an obviously-fake string like 'not-an-email' wouldn't exercise the redaction path at all).

tickets.title: App crashes with a stack trace when exporting to CSV
tickets.body:
Every time I click 'Export to CSV' on a report with more than ~500 rows, the app crashes. Console shows:
TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'length')
  at exportToCsv (report.js:214)
Repro: create a report with 600+ rows, click Export > CSV.
tickets.note: Bug report with a concrete repro and a real stack trace — should classify as bug/P1, not get escalated to P0 just because the word 'crashes' appears.

tickets.title: Possible auth bypass via crafted session token
tickets.body: I found that setting the session cookie to a specially-crafted value (role=admin embedded in an unsigned segment) lets a normal account load the admin dashboard. Happy to share a minimal repro privately rather than posting it here.
tickets.note: Security report — must always land on oversight_gate=confirm regardless of classifier confidence (directive-registry row 2).

tickets.title: Would be great to have keyboard shortcuts for switching tabs
tickets.body: Not urgent, just a nice-to-have: it would speed up my workflow if Ctrl+Tab / Ctrl+Shift+Tab cycled through open report tabs like a browser does.
tickets.note: Clean feature request, low priority, no ambiguity — should auto-resolve to feature-request/P3 with no escalation.

tickets.title: How do I configure a custom date range for the weekly digest?
tickets.body: The docs mention a digest but I can't find where to set the date range in Settings. Is this possible from the UI or only via config file?
tickets.note: Clean question, no repro needed — should auto-resolve to question/P3.

tickets.title: Invoice #4821 double-charged me this month
tickets.body: My card was charged twice for invoice #4821 ($49 each). Please refund the duplicate. You can reach me at jane.doe@example.com or 555-0148 if you need more details.
tickets.note: Billing ticket carrying real-shaped PII (email + phone) in the body — exercises both the directive-registry override (row 1: add team:finance label) and PII redaction (row 3) before anything gets logged.
